}}'''Surandha''' is an [[Wise One apprentice|apprentice]] to the [[Wise One]] [[Sorilea]].

==Appearance==
She has dark golden hair. She is handsome, with large blue eyes, but is quite beautiful when she laughs. She is about five years older than Egwene. She is a strong channeller who can channel as strongly as many Aes Sedai.{{ref/book|6|27}} Her exact strength level in the power is unknown.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Surandha}}

She is an odd apprentice for Sorilea; she often laughed and was full of fun. However, she jumped when Sorilea even thought "jump".

==Activities==
The Wise Ones are hard on Surandha because they are angry at [[Rand]] and the [[Shaido]] Wise Ones.

She is part of the group that whips [[Egwene]] for lying about being [[Aes Sedai]]. She was merciless; however, when Egwene meets her ''toh'', Surandha beams at hear as brightly as ever.

It can be assumed that during the [[Last Battle]] she fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley along the other Wise Ones.
